# Welcome!

Welcome to my penguin data visualization website!

In this project, I use the `penguins` dataset to explore
different characteristics of penguins using R and `ggplot2`.

I will focus on body size, bill characteristics, species,
sex, and island.

## About the data

The `penguins` dataset contains information about penguins
from three different species and several islands.

The main variables I use include:

- body mass
- flipper length
- bill length
- bill depth
- sex
- species
- island

## Goal

The goal of this project is to use data visualization to
better understand patterns and differences among penguins..
